snapshot_note: Completed author draft after translator self-check and early reviewer suggestions, before source-apparatus assembly and final independent QC. Earlier scratch drafts were not fixed releases; exact changed readings are recorded below.

changes.reason: Early independent-review suggestion accepted: preserve established lexical commitment rather than misclassifying a synonym as grammatical inflection.
